title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Adding comments to Factbox/Report (Displaying Comments in a FactBox/Report)
summary: Adding comments to FactBox and reports in Business Central lets users attach contextual information to sales orders and other documents. The post shows how to display sales comments in a ListPart page extension and in reports using report extensions with dataitem linking.
key_points: Comments in Business Central capture extra information on cards and documents, with a limit of 80 characters per comment field.
Comments on documents automatically transfer to related posted documents, and transfer rules can be configured in Sales & Receivables settings.
To display comments in a FactBox, create a ListPart page for Sales Comment Line and add it to the Sales Order page extension using SubPageLink.
Report extensions can add sales comment lines directly as dataitems linked to the header by Document Type and No., enabling comment display in printed reports.

quotes.text: Comments on ongoing documents are transferred to the related posted document.
quotes.why_it_matters: This shows how Business Central automatically maintains comment information throughout the document lifecycle, reducing manual re-entry work.

quotes.text: The Comment field has a length limit of 80 characters, Comment (6, Text[80]).
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding this constraint is critical for developers designing comment capture interfaces and validating user input.
